lessons.title: Meet the studio
lessons.brief: A scene is data: plates, fixtures, props, an effects stack, and the characters placed in it. This check passes when the studio validates against your project.

lessons.title: Light and air
lessons.brief: Ambient life is declared, not rendered by hand: window light, drifting motes, a day grade — all scene data.

lessons.title: The posing stool
lessons.brief: Fixtures anchor bodies to the room: the stool's anchor set names a real part of the character.

lessons.title: HUD basics
lessons.brief: The studio's HUD — take counter, focus peaking — is an effect in the scene's stack, ordered with the rest.

lessons.title: Composition
lessons.brief: A working scene composes: ambient life, a fixture, and an overlay stack, all validating together.

lessons.title: Capstone: the full studio
lessons.brief: Everything at once: the studio validates against your project and carries its whole composition. Pass this and the Scenes track is complete.
